description: Why: duplicated logic in tests diverges silently from the production implementation; the test may continue to pass even if the production pattern-matching logic is changed. What: tests/remote_pin_jobs.rs defines a local group_matches_pattern helper with the comment 'mirrors main.rs logic'. This is a copy of the same function in the production code. The production function should be extracted to a shared module and imported by both the implementation and the test.
title: remote_pin_jobs test embeds group_matches_pattern logic duplicate from main
